extraction: Layout, heading rules, cover, and optional outline were reconstructed from embedded static Typst fragments. Runtime title/subtitle/author interpolation is expressed as function parameters.
reader_adaptations: Progressive batches share the full-document style, omit the global outline, and carry page offsets.

Optional verified system-font downloads match the original Source Han SC and LXGW WenKai versions. Existing CN and Lite subsets remain fallbacks; no external application paths or bundled fonts are needed.

Markdown is still parsed by cmarker with raw Typst disabled. The template entry supplies monospace and superscript font fallbacks, unindented footnote entries, and the original full-width divider without duplicating cmarker's block spacing.
